ledger.claim: The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: trip_record.arrived_at is null, the status is CANCELLED_BY_RIDER and cancelled_by is RIDER. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and its limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event for the trip. That limb fails on the face of the record, and the anchor clause of this category cannot charge the fee.

The driver's own GPS trace places him 5,661 m from the pickup pin at his closest approach and 11,906 m at his furthest, over 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40. Not one fix falls within the 150 m arrival radius for an AIRPORT pickup, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 for the whole trace. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 is explicit that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The 15-minute window (13:53:40 to 14:08:40) fully contains the trace, so there is no gap the driver can hide in.

Even if arrival could somehow be established, the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480 second minimum dwell fixed for the AIRPORT zone class - a shortfall of 480 seconds on the trace's own shortfall_basis. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full for a waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded.

The trip was terminated by the rider, not the driver, and the cancellation_reason_code is RIDER_CHANGED_MIND. POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and requires termination by the driver at or after the dwell elapsed. This record satisfies none of that: the wrong party terminated, and the code is one the clause does not recognise. A fourth independent limb fails.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING - it has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0, so on this record no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. POL-NS-06(i) lets in-geofence intervals be summed only where a present and populated advisory carries an admissible type; with the advisory MISSING that limb is unavailable to the driver, and there are in any event no in-geofence intervals to sum. The absence is itself citable and it does not help the driver.

ledger.claim: The in-app chat shows the driver writing 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40, and the rider replying 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40, one minute before the 14:08:40 cancellation. What the record shows is a rider cancellation prompted by a demand for SGD 120 in cash, not a rider no-show; it confirms that no limb of POL-NS-01 is met and that the fee was never chargeable.

The rider was at the pin throughout the disputed window: 41 qualifying rider fixes, every one within roughly 13 to 23 m of the pickup point, stationary at 0 km/h, far inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for an AIRPORT pickup. Any suggestion that the rider failed to show for her own car is contradicted by her own complete, admissible trace.

Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is available only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied on any limb - no arrived event, no in-radius fix, no dwell, and a reason code outside limb (d) - so no compensation is payable to this driver, and the whole disputed amount must go back to the rider.

The fare breakdown shows the contested SGD 8.00 cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the full contested amount is still held by the platform. Per POL-GEN-03, FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party, and this dispute was filed by the rider - so the SGD 8.00 runs back to her.

Every artifact this case rests on - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes fired. Under POL-GEN-02 the deciding facts are therefore carried at full weight, no confidence cap applies, and the ruling can rest on the evidence without discount.

The trip was terminated by the rider's own election, not by any driver default: the trip_record records cancelled_by = RIDER with cancellation_reason_code = RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, and contains no driver 'arrived' event and no no-show termination. The driver never tapped a false 'arrived' marker and never abandoned the pickup, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival machinery — and the referral against the driver it carries — is not engaged on this record.

The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04: her only chat message is 'no. cancelling.', which is not a locating or coordinating message within limb (a) — it states no position, entrance, block, tower or bay, requests no position, and does not say she cannot see the vehicle. However present she may have been at the pin, limb (a) fails and POL-NS-04 does not dispose of the fee.

The rider's grievance about the driver's pre-pickup price message is not a ground of decision under the loaded policy: neither POLICY-NO-SHOW nor POLICY-GENERAL makes a fare re-quote a licence to reverse the cancellation fee, and the chargeability of the fee is fixed solely by the POL-NS-01 conditions and nothing else.

The SGD 8.00 cancellation line is arithmetically correct and raises no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the fee_schedule resolution rule yields the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), which is exactly the amount itemised in the fare_breakdown, so no mismatch can be turned against the driver who charged it.

The driver's profile clears the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and that count over completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so no withholding is triggered and the record shows no fee-farming pattern; nor does the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger fire.

Honest concession: the driver's own trace never enters the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius — his closest fix is 5,661 m from the pin — with qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. The driver does not contend that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) or (c) are met and does not rest his case on the arrival and dwell arithmetic.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties should see how this was decided. The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 is the only clause that can make a no-show fee chargeable, and it requires all four of its conditions to hold together. Not one of them does on this record. (a) The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: arrived_at is null. (b) The driver's own GPS trace, 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40, never comes closer than 5,661 m to the pickup pin at Changi Terminal 1, reaches 11,906 m at its furthest, and moves at roughly 46 km/h throughout; no fix falls inside the 150 m airport arrival radius, and qualifying_fix_count is 0. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480-second minimum dwell fixed for an AIRPORT pickup, a 480-second shortfall. (d) The trip was terminated by the rider, not the driver, on the code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. Because limb (b) fails with no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before cancellation (13:53:40 to 14:08:40, which fully contains the trace), POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the fee, and POL-NS-06 independently refunds it in full for the waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. Nothing displaces that. POL-NS-03 needs the driver stationary within 400 m of the pin and he was 5,661 m away at his closest approach, so it does not apply. POL-NS-05 is engaged only where a trip_record 'arrived' event is shown to be false; there is no arrival marker on this record at all, so the clause never runs and no false-arrival record is entered against the driver in referrals. On the rider's own position: her trace shows 41 qualifying fixes, every one 13 to 23 m from the pin and stationary, far inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for an airport pickup, so nothing here rests on any failure by her. POL-NS-04 does not apply either, because 'no. cancelling.' is not a locating or coordinating message, but that makes no difference, since the refund follows from the driver's trace alone. On the driver's case: his explanation that the original fare did not cover airport queue time on a holiday and that he told the rider the price before pickup so she could decide is heard, but the loaded policy does not make a mid-trip fare re-quote a ground for or against the fee, and the re-quote is not what decides this case either way. The counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence cap; it is consistent with the chat log, which records the driver's message 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40 and the rider's 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not satisfied on any limb. The anti-farming check would not have blocked payment in any event, since driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against the threshold of 4 and 1 over 110 completed trips is 0.009 against the 0.08 rate, and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. On confidence: the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown all read COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the facts that decide this case, namely no arrived event in the trip record and no in-radius fix in the trace, are carried at full weight by the trip record and the trace, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the ruling rests on unimpaired evidence. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but nothing in this ruling rests on it: the POL-NS-06(i) summing route is unavailable and unnecessary because there are no in-geofence intervals to sum. A rider-side claim about that missing advisory was discarded for not naming its issue code; it is recorded in the audit below and was not needed to reach the result. The fare arithmetic is sound in any event: SGD 8.00 is the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee of SGD 8.00, exactly as the fare breakdown itemises, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). The SGD 8.00 was charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.0; it now goes back to the rider in full.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
